message.reasoning_content: You Won't See Me — Rubber Soul, Dec 1965. Nearer 1970? Midpoint 1966. 1965 is nearer 1962? 1965 vs midpoint 1966 → nearer 1962? No, 1965 is 3 years from 1962, 5 from 1970, so nearer 1962 → "no".
